assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope in the setting of known atrial fibrillation and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying rhythm disturbances and to guide further management.
